name_resolution.rationale: TaiCOL and Tai2 returned no exact Taiwan species record or public Chinese name. Kew POWO independently confirms Urceola elastica Roxb. as an accepted species, but no Taiwan government or academic source was found pairing this species with a Traditional Chinese public name. Taiwan public names 乳藤 and 酸藤 apply to other Urceola species and are not transferred. The result remains unresolved rather than inventing or borrowing a Chinese name.
